newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse opening delayed due comms problems.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse opening delayed due comms problems.

text.p: The opening of Lisbon bourse has been delayed due to computer problems with the Tradis trading system and floor trade is expected to begin at 1000 GMT, a bourse spokesman said.
"We have not been able to get the Tradis trading system to start. Floor trade will begin at 1000 GMT," Luis Rodrigues told Reuters.
He could not say when the computer problems would be solved.
